1. **Goal and done-criteria**: Implement 3 milestones in the Python-Markdown `markdown/extensions/toc.py` file: - **m1**: Add three new public functions (`striptags`, `render_inner_html`, `run_postprocessors`) to the toc module. `striptags` must strip HTML tags without unescaping entities (e.g., `

Hello & world

` → `'Hello & world'`). All three must be importable from `markdown.extensions.toc`. - **m2**: Modify `TocTreeprocessor.run` to use the new helpers instead of deprecated `get_name`/`stashedHTML2text`, applying postprocessors to heading content before stripping tags. - **m3**: Save `name`, `html`, and `data-toc-label` keys in each `toc_tokens` entry; apply `html.unescape` only immediately before `slugify` (not on name/html/data-toc-label). Done-criteria: Each milestone passes all existing tests, produces exactly one commit, and follows the observable behaviors specified in the plan. 2. **Constraints and rules in force**: - Work in `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/p5b/run/swarm/factory/runs/sw-markdown-20f781e2/ws/oracle` (git repo with `base` tag at commit `08dacae`). - Only modify library source files (no test files, no packaging/CI changes). - Run the full test suite after each milestone; every previously-passing test must still pass. - One commit per milestone: `git add -A && git commit -q -m "mK: "`. - Use `python` tool only for execution; `repo.*` tools available but shell commands via subprocess also work. - Context is nearly full; compact when possible. 3. **User and supervisor messages**: The initial TASK message from the oracle_builder role defines the hand-off JSON at `/handoff/handoff.json` with 3 milestones (m1, m2, m3) and their requirements. 4. **Entities and ids touched**: - File modified: `markdown/extensions/toc.py` — added `striptags`, `render_inner_html`, `run_postprocessors` functions before `nest_toc_tokens` (line ~101). - Test results: 696 passed, 130 skipped, 4 failed (pre-existing failures in `test_html_blocks.py`: `test_raw_missing_close_bracket`, `test_raw_unclosed_tag_in_code_span_space`, `test_unclosed_comment_`). These are NOT caused by m1 changes. - Base commit: `08dacae618775831243f6bbab47d9be590d511f2`. 5. **Pending and waiting items**: - **m1**: Functions implemented and verified working in isolation. Need to run full test suite to confirm no regressions, then commit. - **m2**: Not yet started. Requires modifying `TocTreeprocessor.run` to call `run_postprocessors` and `striptags`/`render_inner_html`. - **m3**: Not yet started. Requires saving `name`/`html`/`data-toc-label` tokens and adding `html.unescape` before `slugify`. 6. **Errors and fixes**: - Initial `write_file` via World tool produced garbled output with line numbers prepended. Fixed by using `subprocess` to read/write the file directly. - `striptags` initially used `html.parser.HTMLParser` which was unescaping entities. Fixed by switching to `re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)` regex approach. - Pre-existing test failures in `test_html_blocks.py` (4 tests) are unrelated to m1 changes — they existed before any modifications. 7. **Current hypothesis**: The m1 implementation is correct — `striptags` uses regex to strip tags while preserving entities, `render_inner_html` serializes children via `md.serializer`, and `run_postprocessors` iterates through `md.postprocessors`. The 4 failing tests are pre-existing issues in the codebase, not caused by our changes. 8. **Next step**: - Verify m1 doesn't cause any NEW test failures by running the full test suite excluding the known pre-existing failures. - If clean, commit m1: `git add -A && git commit -q -m "m1: Add run_postprocessors, render_inner_html, and striptags to toc module"`. - Then implement m2: modify `TocTreeprocessor.run` to replace `get_name`/`stashedHTML2text` calls with `run_postprocessors(md, render_inner_html(md, el))` followed by `striptags()`. 9. **Variables worth remembering**: - `striptags(text)`: regex-based HTML tag stripper that preserves entities. - `render_inner_html(md, elem)`: serializes children of an etree element. - `run_postprocessors(md, text)`: runs all md.postprocessors on text. - The `TocTreeprocessor.run` method (lines ~290-339 in original) currently uses `get_name(el)` and `unescape(stashedHTML2text(...))` — these need to be replaced. - `toc_tokens` entries (currently have `level`, `id`, `name`) need `html` and `data-toc-label` keys added.
